lines.t: Like water in a desert land, like fire against the cold
His words bring life and warmth again, more precious fire than gold
Like light that breaks the darkest sky, like dawn that ends the night
Every word he speaks is shining
Full of mercy, truth and light
His words are beautiful
More precious than gold
When I'm hungry they leave me full
More than any food you hold
Each letter is like a jewel
Shining bright
Every word I drop from heaven
And into this night
Oh, His words
When my heart is tight and empty
And the road feels long and wide
Every word He sends like rain
Falls with peace I cannot hide
Full of kindness, full of wisdom
Full of love, it never ends
Every whisper from the heavens
Is a treasure that He sends
I could read them every morning
I could sing them through the day
Every word a shining treasure
Lighting up my way
His words are beautiful
More precious than gold
When I'm hungry they leave me full
More than any food you hold
Each letter is like a jewel shining bright
Every word I drop from heaven into this life
Oh, His words
Like rain upon the desert sand
Like light upon the sea
Every word He's spoken brings new life to me
Forever I will treasure
The truth that He gives
For every word from heaven
Heaven is the reason that I live.
His words are beautiful, more precious than gold.
When I'm hungry, they leave me full, more than any food you hold.
Each letter is like a jewel, shining bright.
Every word that dropped from heaven into this night
Oh, His words
Oh, His words
